# tier 2, group smooth, route replay, version payload 1.3, role ab
# MSC_SLIP_BUDGET_MS=0 (the Vita plan sets 30 since wave 9: a late frame is cut only from a 30 ms bucket that fills at 2 % of real time, so a sustained overload runs the game at 98 % of real time, not 83 %). Against the default: the `[slip] match #n` lines (game time lost to slip of the match's play time, the worst 2 s window, fixed steps a second of play: 50.00 is exact) and by eye whether the game is in slow motion while frames are late; the stateless rule loses up to 17-20 % of game time in a scene that is late every frame. MSC_PACE_LOG=0 rides on this run (the [pace] lines are a diagnostic with no effect on timing beyond a log line a window). Single player only. Host table: native/tools/fps/run_slip_budget_test.sh.
